key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:21E4
name: unpack_masked_run_length_stream
description: Decompresses a packed stream whose header gives the output length and a fill byte. Control bytes select a run of the next stream byte, a run of the header fill byte, or a literal copy, and zero bytes are skipped so existing destination values are kept.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:2252
name: unpack_remaining_run_packets
description: Continues the same unpacking loop through the run and literal packets that follow the first one, until the output length is reached. It repeats the fill byte for the two fill-run codes and copies literal bytes otherwise.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:2276
name: decode_packed_run_fragment
description: Holds a fragment of the same unpacker that handles a two-byte run packet, a fill-byte run and a literal copy. Each packet is decoded into the destination with zero bytes left unwritten.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:229E
name: decode_run_packets_until_limit
description: Reads packets in the same format and writes their bytes to the destination until the output count reaches its limit. Run packets repeat either the packet's own byte or the fill byte, and literal packets copy bytes directly.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:22C6
name: stub_return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value it was passed on the stack without changing it, and performs no other work.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:238C
name: open_dos_file_handle
description: Opens a file through the DOS library's open function and stores the returned file handle for later reads. It returns no value of its own.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:23AE
name: poll_and_read_valid_byte
description: Polls the DOS input for a waiting byte. When one is present it reads it and marks it valid only if it is nonzero and below 123; otherwise it clears the valid flag.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:241E
name: read_validated_input_byte
description: Reads one byte from the DOS input unconditionally, setting the valid flag before the read. The byte is kept as valid only if it is nonzero and below 123.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:247A
name: close_dos_file_handle
description: Closes the file handle through the DOS library's close function, with no other work of its own.

key: caesar deluxe (1993)(impressions)[cr atx](disk 1 of 2)[hd]/Caesar Deluxe (1993)(Impressions)[cr ATX](Disk 1 of 2)[HD].adf:INSTALL.EXE:0:2496
name: drain_pending_input_bytes
description: Repeatedly polls the DOS input and reads each waiting byte, setting the valid flag each time, until no input is left.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0008
name: setup_custom_chips_and_copper
description: Saves the current interrupt and DMA enable state, disables both, clears the sprite pointer registers and writes the copper list entries for colour and sprite data. It then installs an interrupt handler in a system structure and waits for a raster line before continuing.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:02BC
name: advance_ping_pong_buffer_pair
description: Calls four helper routines, then writes a new address made from the second stored value plus 350 into two words, and swaps the two stored values so they alternate each time.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0304
name: load_three_table_bytes
description: For a nonzero index above 16, reads three byte values at a four-byte stride into three variables. For indexes below 10 it stores the index minus one and calls a helper routine.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:035E
name: swap_buffer_pair_stepping_back
description: Calls two helper routines, then writes a new address made from the second stored value minus 2 into two words and swaps the two stored values.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:039A
name: pass_through_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:03C2
name: store_shifted_values_twice
description: Calls a helper, stores the incoming value shifted right by three into one variable, calls the helper again, and stores the value shifted right by six into a second variable.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:03E0
name: step_and_mask_coordinate_pair
description: Adds a delta word to each of two position words, then keeps only bits 1 to 11 of each result, so the values stay even and within twelve bits.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:041C
name: start_blitter_operation
description: Calls a helper, then programs the blitter by setting the word masks, control register, destination modulo and destination address, and starts a fixed-size blit.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0428
name: start_blitter_operation
description: Calls a helper, then programs the blitter by setting the word masks, control register, destination modulo and destination address, and starts a fixed-size blit.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0458
name: advance_interrupt_state_machine
description: When a flag bit is set, reads a value through a helper and steps a small state machine: a waiting state counts down to zero, a counting state runs for 110 steps before moving to a final state, and the flag bit is then cleared.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:04FC
name: start_blitter_operation_variant
description: Calls a helper, then programs the blitter with the same word masks, control register, modulo and destination setup as the other blitter starts, but with a different fixed blit size, and starts it.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0546
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Busy-waits while the blitter busy flag is set in the hardware status register, then returns.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0556
name: reset_text_scan_state
description: Resets the text scanning state: points the read position at a fixed data address, clears a column counter, sets a row counter to one and clears a flag byte.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:057A
name: parse_text_stream_character
description: Reads one character of a text stream. Zero bytes are skipped to the next nonzero byte, code 1 restarts the stream at its fixed start, and a carriage return or a full line of 41 characters starts a new row; other characters go to a helper and advance the column count.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:05DE
name: advance_text_stream_after_char
description: Advances the column count first, starting a new row at 41 columns, then reads the next character with the same rules: zero bytes are skipped, code 1 restarts the stream, carriage returns start a new row, and other characters go to a helper.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:05F2
name: start_text_row_then_parse
description: Clears the column count and increments the row count, then reads the next character of the stream with the same rules: zero bytes are skipped, code 1 restarts the stream, and other characters go to a helper.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0642
name: setup_blitter_masked_copy
description: Programs a blit by setting the source data registers to all ones, the modulo and pointers from two inputs, and the word masks and control values from whether each input is odd or even. In one case it offsets the pointers by fixed amounts and starts a larger blit.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:070C
name: build_copper_colour_table_block
description: Writes two fixed copper move pairs at fixed offsets from the block base, then copies 64 entries from a table of six-word records into two interleaved halves of the copper list.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:071C
name: build_copper_colour_table_second
description: Calls a helper, then writes two fixed copper move pairs at a second pair of block offsets and copies 64 six-word table records into two interleaved halves of that copper list.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:073A
name: copy_copper_colour_table_block
description: Writes two fixed copper move headers into the destination, then copies 64 six-word table records into two interleaved halves of the destination list through the given pointers.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0762
name: set_copper_list_pointers
description: Writes the low and high words of four copper list addresses, each offset from a base pointer by a fixed block offset, into the copper pointer locations, and then stores a fixed control word.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:07E6
name: encode_sprite_position_words
description: Halves a horizontal start value and a second value offset by 16, keeps the low bits of each, and merges in the high bits of a further value. The packed words are written into two control lists, in the layout the sprite position registers expect.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0C14
name: set_table_end_pointer
description: Stores the input address as the current table pointer and computes the end of that table, which starts with a count word followed by four-byte entries, and stores that end address too.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0C16
name: toggle_flag_after_helper
description: Calls a helper routine, then flips the lowest bit of a stored flag value.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0C18
name: save_parameters_then_run_helpers
description: Saves the two address parameters and two word parameters into stored variables, then runs three helper routines in sequence.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0C64
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Busy-waits while the blitter busy flag is set in the hardware status register, then returns.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0C74
name: start_blitter_rectangle_blit
description: Computes the width in words and height in rows of a rectangle from four stored coordinates, then programs the blitter with a first-word mask, control register, destination address and modulo, and starts a blit of that size.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0CEE
name: start_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Computes the width and height of a rectangle from stored coordinates, then programs the blitter with source and destination pointers, modulos and a copy-mode control register, and starts the blit.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0D76
name: project_coordinate_list_points
description: Walks a counted list of coordinate pairs, scaling each by a masked 10-bit fixed-point factor and offsetting it by 160 horizontally and 128 vertically into an output buffer, and calls a helper for each point.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0DC0
name: dispatch_indexed_pairs_to_helper
description: Walks a counted table of index pairs and, for each pair, looks up two words in a lookup table at four-byte stride, then passes them with the next index to a helper routine.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0DF8
name: set_default_bounds_rectangle
description: Writes four fixed words, 160, 160, 128 and 128, into the bounds record, which resets the stored rectangle to a default extent.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0E28
name: expand_bounds_rectangle
description: Widens a stored bounding box to include a new point, lowering the minimum and raising the maximum of each axis where needed.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:0E86
name: start_blitter_line_draw
description: Orders two endpoints, computes the blitter line parameters from their horizontal and vertical distances, sets the line control and pixel masks, and starts a line draw into the destination.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:1150
name: build_linked_entry_table
description: Builds a table of 30 linked entries in a memory block, zeroing each entry and recording its address in a pointer list, then sets the status flags to 15.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:1152
name: update_audio_channel_pointers
description: Advances a frame counter and, when it reaches its limit, runs the audio helpers and loads the four audio channel start pointers from stored addresses, with short delays between writes.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:1154
name: clear_audio_channel_state
description: Clears four audio state variables to zero and then sets a final control variable to 15, resetting the state of the four audio channels.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:122E
name: select_audio_channel_period
description: Calls helpers, then looks up a value for the current channel state, choosing the table column from the frame count modulo three, and writes it to the audio channel register. It returns the resulting state.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:12C4
name: step_audio_channel_sequence
description: Steps one audio channel through its sequence: when the current word is zero it loads the next word, then sets the channel sample address, length and volume from a per-instrument table, applying any effect in the word and switching the channel DMA on.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:153C
name: process_audio_channel_command
description: Processes one tick of an audio channel command byte. When the command nibble is zero it selects a value from a table indexed by the frame count, otherwise it applies the command, and stores the result into the channel period word.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:15AC
name: copy_record_word_field
description: Copies one word from a fixed offset in a source record into a fixed offset in the destination record.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:16B6
name: find_period_table_entry
description: Searches a table of 37 word values for the first entry at least as large as the current masked period, steps back one entry when a flag bit is set, and stores the chosen value as the target, setting a direction flag when the target is below the current period.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:1726
name: apply_pitch_slide_step
description: Moves a channel pitch value up or down by a step each tick until it reaches the target, then clears the slide count. It uses a table lookup to return the matching entry.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:17D0
name: modulate_channel_period_wave
description: Computes a modulation offset for an audio channel: it reads a waveform value from a table or a ramp, scales it by a depth nibble, adds it to the base period, and advances the phase.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:19D8
name: dispatch_audio_effect_command
description: Dispatches a channel effect nibble: some values store a byte as a position or volume, one sets a repeat counter, and one clamps the volume to 64.

key: runtime segment $004080-$005D70:0:1ADA
name: store_channel_nibble_field
description: Stores the low four bits of a byte from the channel record into a second field of that record.

key: blues brothers, the (1991)(titus)[cr company][t +5 legend]/Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: read_disk_blocks_into_memory

name: start_loaded_program_entry

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0090
name: initialise_display_copper_list

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0384
name: clear_block_and_wait_frames
description: Clears a block of 456 words, sets two stored addresses and a count, then loops waiting for the beam to reach a line, calling helpers on each pass.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:03D6
name: run_step_sequence_until_done

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0416
name: run_frame_step_loop_entry
description: Entry into the frame step loop: it sets a state byte, selects the next source pointer from a table (using a default when the entry is the end marker), and runs the loop that clears a block and waits for frames once the state reaches two.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0420
name: step_back_frame_sequence

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:045C
name: reset_frame_sequence_state
description: Clears the state byte, runs a helper, selects the next source pointer, and then runs the wait-and-finish loop that returns once the state reaches two.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0468
name: advance_colour_step_frame
description: Counts down a frame counter and, when it reaches zero, moves a step index forward by two, wrapping after 456 entries. It then copies the table words for the current step into their stored colour destinations, eleven entries in all.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0542
name: run_frame_wait_loop_fragment

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:055C
name: remap_row_colours_to_copper

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0578

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:05C6
name: write_indexed_list_block_entries

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:0620

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$C4C00 to $040000 (47616 bytes):0:068E
name: copy_system_view_pointers

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:08D4
name: reset_six_record_defaults
description: Sets one field in each of six eight-byte records to 16, writing it twice, and then sets two stored pointers to the same default value.

name: build_image_entry_tables
description: For each entry in a table of image pointers, copies three plane blocks of the decoded size into the output buffer, then interleaves them into the entry's final word-aligned layout.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:109C
name: index_image_group_pointers
description: Loads a resource through a helper, then for each group in its header records the group's start address in a pointer table, advancing by a size computed from the group's width, height and a mode flag.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:113C
name: index_image_groups_single_mode
description: Loads a resource through a helper, then records the start address of each group in a pointer table, advancing by a size computed from its width and height. It then adds six to a stored counter.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:11B2
name: build_256_entry_address_table
description: Fills a table of 256 entries with addresses, each 26 bytes after the previous one, starting from a fixed base address.

name: encode_group_into_plane_rows
description: Re-encodes an image group row by row, writing a count word and packed row data into the output, and recording each row's start address in a pointer table.

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:13A4
name: merge_four_bitplanes_into_words

name: index_fixed_stride_records

name: fill_pointer_table_by_stride

name: load_fixed_resource_block

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:17A4

key: Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr Company][t +5 Legend].adf boot-block load +$ACC00 to $030000 (98304 bytes):0:6FE4
